digest.component_or_area: metrics event derivation over durable ticket store
propositions: Read-only metric derivations over a hybrid source (compiled state for terminal values, raw event files for per-event and multi-occurrence data) must correctly handle both active and compaction-retired events using authoritative helpers event_sort_key and is_active_event.

Attempts-per-ticket metric must count distinct claim sessions by scanning raw STATUS events on open→in_progress edges and collecting unique session values; a ticket with two distinct sessions yields exactly 2.
Rework-within-days(n) metric must detect closed→open→closed transitions and measure the interval between edges using raw event timestamps, correctly excluding gaps longer than n days.

First-pass-rate metric must identify tickets never reopened by checking absence of last_reopened_at in compiled state; revert-recovery must filter reverts by target_event_type to count only substantive reversions (STATUS/COMMITS, not COMMENT/LINK).

Reopen-recovery metric must count all tickets with ≥1 closed→open STATUS edge in range via raw event scan; metrics over empty ranges return None (Unavailable), while populated ranges with zero qualifying events return 0 (measured zero).
All metrics must register into registry.py with source=structural and confidence=high, and pass unit tests confirming session/rework/revert counting and retired-event inclusion.
